description: General arrangement drawing of a twin independent rudder steering system installed across the stern of a vessel. Perspective, plan, transverse section, and local details show port and starboard rudder stocks/blades, upper and lower bearing/support structures, steering cylinders, rudder arms, rod links, sheave boxes, wire-rope/cable runs, central track/car support, hull shell, longitudinal tri-beams, and transverse partitions. Connectivity: each rudder stock is operated by its own steering cylinder connected to a rudder arm. A rod link from each rudder arm connects toward the central movable car/track arrangement. Wire ropes/cables run from the central track/car toward port and starboard lower sheave boxes, pass around sheaves, and continue upward/outboard as shown, mechanically coordinating the two rudders while retaining independent actuation. The sheave boxes are bonded horizontally. The port and starboard arrangements are mirrored about vessel centerline (CL). Structural attachment is to upper bearing structure DWG 108-05-151-001, lower bearing structure DWG 108-05-151-002, TRI-BEAM 11, PARTITION LM1, PARTITION LM2, hull shell, and track support with 16 mm tapping plate insert DWG 108-01-150-004. Detail A depicts the cable/track interface; port lower sheave box detail depicts cable routing around the sheaves. Section B-B shows the hidden arrangement in PARTITION LM1; Section C-C shows the rudder blade through the rudder stock; Details D and E show local bearing/support and linkage interfaces. System notes state rudders have 1.8° toe-in angle in neutral with rod links 2044 mm long, adjustable by changing rod lengths; car race is ±365 mm from CL. Ackermann-effect table relates car position to inside/outside rudder angles. Safety notes state no emergency steering system is needed; there are 3 independent systems in place: 2 wheels plus pilot; with one rod failure one rudder remains active, with one wheel failure the second wheel remains in control of both rudders, and with both wheels failed the pilot remains in control. Drawing title: Steering System GA; drawing number 108-01-150-001; format A1; scale NTS; date 23 AUG 2022; revision B dated 13 Dec 2022, DIMS ADDED.
